shortDescription.default: Viva Connections card that surfaces a Work IQ 'what's relevant today' summary.

longDescription.default: PrimaryTextCard-WorkIQ-TodaySummary shows a short, Work IQ-generated summary of what's relevant to the signed-in user today (files, meetings, messages) on the Viva Connections dashboard, with a Quick View listing the underlying items.
